{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# The comma rows were found earlier — they are not test orders, but real data with thousands separators
# We already know they exist and are not test orders
# Reapply cleaning to ensure consistency
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
data['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(data['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Now filter for completed orders (exclude refunded)
completed_orders = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue_completed"}
